messages.text:
The compatibility audit found a verifier bug too: the semantic-invalid verifier was printing failures but returning success if fewer than 20 appeared.

I’m correcting that gate and two runtime differences it exposed: empty-string command output should still emit a newline, and malformed glob patterns should fail.

commands.commandLine: Copy-Item nushell_port.py executable -Force; python -m py_compile nushell_port.py .tura/scripts/diff_verify.py .tura/scripts/valid_diff_verify.py
commands.preview: Copy-Item nushell_port.py executable -Force; python -m py_compile nushell_port.py .tura/scripts/diff_verify.py .tura/scripts/valid_diff_verify.py
